name: dillon-os-agents-sdk
description: OpenAI Agents SDK dependencies for local Dillon OS workflows

scripts.check: node --input-type=module -e "import {Agent, Runner, tool} from '@openai/agents'; import {z} from 'zod'; import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; assert.equal(typeof Agent, 'function'); assert.equal(typeof Runner, 'function'); assert.equal(typeof tool, 'function'); assert.ok(z); console.log('PASS: SDK and Zod imports; no API calls');"
